details: Ok I never figured to report this issue becuase it seemed like such an obvious bug that VRC MUST be aware of that I figured it was unnecessary to report. That or someone else has already reported it. Seriously though, when are you guys going to fix the instance lists displaying properly??? When in game for awhile, the list of active instances and the number of players in those instances gets DRASTICALLY out of sync. I just cycled through 3 instances that said had 3, 5, and 15 players in and all three were completely empty. This has been an issue for seemingly years, but has been worse as of late. The only way to temporarily fix it to see the most up to date list of active instances and see the most up to date player counts in those instances is to restart the game. Am I crazy or is everyone else just thinking "surely someone else has already reported this so I dont need to". Please help VRC.
title: Player count in instance list wrong
